From 1152 and 432:
- \(1152 \div 432 = 2\) remainder \(288\)
- \(432 \div 288 = 1\) remainder \(144\)
- \(288 \div 144 = 2\) remainder \(0\)

So \(\gcd(6192, 7344) = 144\).

Now check with \(8892\):
- \(8892 \div 144 = 61\) remainder \(108\)
- \(144 \div 108 = 1\) remainder \(36\)
- \(108 \div 36 = 3\) remainder \(0\)

Thus \(\gcd(6192, 7344, 8892) = 36\).

Since \(36 > 35\), it satisfies all remainder conditions.

\boxed{36}
